summary: Direct physical MCP writes without target- and operation-bound authorization must be disabled across typed, semantic, and Cobra mirrored tools, with honest descriptions of blocked operations.
reason: Raw device endpoints and the semantic and Cobra command mirrors bypass the one-time plan authorization used by the CLI workflow executor. Keep them closed until they share that protocol; do not infer approval from an unbound token or host write flag. MCP tool descriptions must state that direct calls are disabled and point to authorized sequences or workflows where supported.
